ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABDL) reported Q1 FY27 income growth of 5.8% and volume growth of 6.2%, significantly driven by its premiumization strategy with ICONiQ White's 33.8% surge and overall 10.7% growth in the Prestige & Above segment, outperforming the industry. Despite a material ₹24 crore impact from global supply chain disruptions affecting reported profitability, the company achieved strong underlying gross margin expansion and EBITDA growth, reduced net debt, and progressed on backward integration. A key concern is the substantial ₹400 crore overdue from the Telangana government, alongside the need for successful relaunches of other underperforming premium brands to meet ambitious mid-to-high teens revenue and margin growth targets.
